reports.title: Marie Zarins: Prevention of future deaths report

promises.quote: We will capture the learning from this inquest and other SI reports produced by the Trust and will share this learning across the Trust through our learning forums and Quality Improvement Collaboratives.
promises.summary: Implement quality improvement programme to enhance MDT meeting documentation and recording.

promises.quote: The Trust was unable to contact the Locum Consultant for input into the original SI investigation due to not holding the latest contact details; the Locum Consultant was no longer contracted to work with the Trust, and they had left the country.
promises.summary: Update contact details and engage locum consultant for future investigations.

promises.quote: We confirm that prior to the MDT meeting, the Locum Consultant accessed SystmOne for a period of seven minutes. We also confirm that they did not raise any concerns regarding MDT meetings with the Clinical or Medical Director.
promises.summary: Require locum consultants to review patient records before MDT meetings.

promises.quote: We will provide further detail of this MDT meeting in our review of the initial SI report.
promises.summary: Document second MDT meeting details in SI review.

promises.quote: The Serious Incident Investigation failed to identify the errors in the care provided to Miss Zarins making the use of the process somewhat otiose in this case.
promises.summary: Improve critical analysis in Serious Incident investigations.

concerns.quote: I am concerned about the CRISIS team MDT meetings and their functionality. It is difficult to understand how a meeting attended by around 7 people agreed a treatment plan which was based upon incorrect information relating to the patient's medication status. This is particularly difficult to understand when the correct medication status is clearly documented in the patient's core assessment paperwork (which was completed by the Liaison Team on 22 November 2021 and sent to the CRISIS Team).
concerns.hazard: incorrect medication information in MDT meetings

concerns.quote: I remain concerned about both the standard of documentation and lack of documentation relating to the discussion of Miss Zarins at the two MDT meetings. The Trust were only able to provide me with documentation relating to one of the two MDT meetings. That documentation is incorrectly completed and lacks detail. In particular, there is no detail about medication despite there being a specific box within which to document this.
concerns.hazard: poor and missing documentation of MDT discussions

concerns.quote: I remain gravely concerned about the inadequacies in the Serious Incident Investigation and Reporting processes at Leicestershire Partnership NHS Trust.

reports.title: Christopher Larsen: Prevention of future deaths report

concerns.quote: I am concerned about the Leicestershire Partnership NHS Trust MDT meetings and their functionality
The MDT meeting therefore proceeded, and made decisions based upon, incorrect information
concerns.hazard: incorrect information in multidisciplinary team documentation

concerns.quote: The Trust's SI report states that it was "unclear why it was felt the risks had subsided by the time of discharge on 3.12.2022"
concerns.hazard: unclear risk assessment rationale at discharge

concerns.quote: there was no planned support for Mr Larsen post-discharge other than some counselling which was due to start three weeks later
concerns.hazard: lack of post-discharge support for high-risk patient

concerns.quote: I remain concerned about inadequacies in the Serious Incident Investigation and Reporting processes at Leicestershire Partnership NHS Trust
it failed to uncover all the matters arising at inquest and, some of the matters that it did uncover do not have correlating items of work listed in the action plan
concerns.hazard: incomplete action plan for serious incident investigation

links.explanation: Both reports highlight inadequacies in the Trust's Serious Incident Investigation and Reporting processes. They differ in the specific cases examined (Miss Zarins vs Mr Larsen) and the particular aspects of the process criticised.

links.later_quote: The Serious Incident Investigation into Mr [name redacted] death did uncover and accepted some failings in relation to the care provided to Mr Larsen.
